name: Guilty Pleasure
source:
The game starts with a normal morning, in which you get a call from your best friend, who wants your help in planning the high school graduation party. What you didn't expect, was that this little party would awaken new feelings in you, and in the person now closest to you.

These feelings will have a long-reaching effect on your life and on your household dynamic, as the two of you start to pull those you care about into your newfound Guilty Pleasure.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
游戏从一个平常的早晨开始，你接到最好的朋友的电话，他需要你帮助策划高中毕业派对。你没想到的是，这个小聚会会唤醒你以及现在最亲近的人的新感情。

这些感觉将对你的生活和家庭动态产生深远的影响，因为你们两个开始将你关心的人带入新发现的罪恶之乐中。

[来自F95Zone]
